claims.claim: California limits collection proceedings by debt buyers.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
claims.note: The restriction is conditional on expiration of the applicable limitations period.

claims.claim: The restriction is part of the Fair Debt Buying Practices Act.
claims.note: The excerpt gives the section number but not the act title.

claims.claim: A debt buyer may not sue to collect a consumer debt once the applicable time limit has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
claims.note: The relevant period is the one applicable to the debt buyer’s claim.

claims.claim: A debt buyer may not start arbitration to collect a consumer debt once that time limit has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.

claims.claim: A debt buyer may not start another legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt once that time limit has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
claims.note: Other legal proceedings are expressly included.

claims.claim: If sued over an old debt, raise its age with the court.
claims.note: The section restricts the buyer; it gives no court-response instruction.

claims.claim: If sued over an old debt, get help.
claims.note: The excerpt gives no such instruction.

claims.claim: This section addresses debt buyers; an original creditor suing requires a different analysis.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit
claims.note: The text identifies the regulated party but supplies no rule or definition for original creditors.

flags.text: The last sentence uses “old debt” as its trigger. Age alone does not establish that the applicable limitations period has expired.
“Raise that with the court and get help” directs the reader what to do in a lawsuit without a procedural source.
The excerpt does not verify the act title or explain the treatment of original creditors.

result.summary: Section 1788.56 supports the filing prohibition for all three types of proceedings when the limitations period on the debt buyer’s claim has expired. It does not establish what a defendant should do in court.
